about: Built by tools/build_jfk.py. Walls and floors are traced from I. M. Pei’s 1979 plans of the building. Which exhibit is in which room is approximate: the exhibits were rebuilt in 1993 and the museum’s own map could not be read, so they are placed from visitors’ accounts of the route.
source: I. M. Pei & Partners, plans of Level 1 and Level 2 (1979, via WikiArquitectura); OpenStreetMap; visitors’ accounts of the route
units: pixels of the 1979 drawing x 2 (one pixel is about 0.175 m); north is up and to the left
